prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night, inside a small cold 1930s kitchen, the camera low on the table just behind an identical 1930s wooden cathedral-top radio with a glowing amber dial: its glowing amber dial and carved wooden top fill the near foreground on the left. Leaning in towards it, large in frame, a white man in his forties in a vest with stubble and a Black woman in her forties with her hair tied up in a scarf, their real-skinned faces lit amber from below by the dial, rapt, mouths slightly open, nodding along. A red scarf hangs on the back of a chair; one warm bulb above; snow on the black window behind them and the small red moon. Most of the frame in shadow; the brightest values are the dial and its glow on their faces. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
